name: Essen (North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Essen (two shields, a black double-headed eagle on yellow and a sword on blue, beneath a crown).
history: The flag shows the city arms on a horizontally striped yellow and blue cloth; a plain yellow over blue flag is also used.

features.role: Essen arms — double-headed eagle and sword beneath a crown
